animation_contract.principle: Motion communicates work state; no random decoration or live-action implication.

recommended_timing.loop: only while station is working, max 2-3 repeats unless explicitly active

forbidden_motion: worker snapping through center after click
text/proof-panel motion as substitute for room action

integration_sequence: Use public/war-room/v40/local-visual-kit-v2 cell backgrounds as cell image surfaces.
On cell click, mount one centered popup with the popup-frame overlay and room viewport.
Place worker token, station prop, packet effect in documented popup_room_slots.
Use packet_route_animation_frame_00..07 only for a local source-to-target action.
verification_expectations: browser QA: cells-only -> click cell -> popup -> station/action -> close -> cells-only; console clean; no live actions
